Thanks,

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the screenshot. Sorry for the interruption here. I’ve looped in Ben from billing to confirm whether a backend issuance hit failed, and Monica from onboarding in case we need to re-run the grant flow.

Quick asks so we can move faster:
- Can you confirm the email used to sign up (if different from your contact address)?
- If you have the onboarding confirmation email, please forward it.

Ben/Monica — I see a matching HubSpot deal (DEAL-2027-ACME-53). Please check: 1) was the promo code validated at signup, 2) did the issuance webhook fire, and 3) if the webhook failed, can we do a manual credit grant for $5,000 (promo amount) and record a follow-up ticket?

I’ll keep Emma updated.

— Vanessa

Forwarding internal diagnostics we pulled from the issuance service:

--- internal log excerpt ---
timestamp: 2027-04-27T09:12:34Z
request_id: r-8f3a2b
email: emma@acme.ai
promo_code: ACME-REDWOOD-50
validation: success
issuance_webhook: delivered
issuance_ack: 2027-04-27T09:12:40Z
ledger_update: delayed (parent job queued)
status: pending
--- end excerpt ---

Looks like the issuance webhook was delivered to the ledger worker but the ledger job got queued and never processed due to a transient DB lock on the credits ledger shard. I kicked off a manual re-process and attached an account export showing zero balance currently. If the re-process completes cleanly we should see a +5000 credit line on the account.

I recommend we: 1) manually grant the credit now (to unblock Acme), 2) follow up with SRE/infra to clear the shard lock issue, and 3) issue a post-mortem if more than one customer was affected.

Attachments: account_export_0427.csv

— Ben
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo code applied but credit balance not updating

Emma — quick update and resolution: thanks for your patience. Ben confirmed the issuance worker encountered a transient ledger shard lock which prevented the automated grant from completing. I’ve approved a one-off manual grant of $5,000 to your account (transaction id: TX-20270429-ACME-1) so you should see the credit immediately in the console. Can you confirm you see the updated balance and that you can run a short smoke test?

Root cause & next steps (internal):
- Root cause: transient DB lock in credits ledger shard during automated issuance.
- Immediate mitigation: manual grant completed and notice sent to SRE.
- Follow-up: Ben will open INF-7212 and work with infra to add retry + alerting on queued ledger jobs; Monica will add an onboarding check to surface issuance failures to users sooner.

We’re also creating a small credit to compensate for the delay (additional $200) — that will appear as a separate line item. Apologies for the disruption and thanks for flagging this early.

— Vanessa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
